invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2200（基于ATR 17.1和-4.8%风险），或融资费率Z-score升至>-20%（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格 < SMA50 $2144.78）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2200 (based on ATR 17.1 and -4.8% risk), or funding Z-score rises to >-20% (short pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2144.78).

invalidation.zh: 价格跌破79.50（日线前低），或融资费率Z-score升至-50%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势确认下跌（价格<SMA50 $85.56且持续）。
invalidation.en: Price breaks below 79.50 (daily low), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend confirms bearish (price < SMA50 $85.56 and sustained).
